section_summary.extract_value: This section (5.3) reports on test-retest reliability of breast size variables (current and ideal breast size, and signed/unsigned breast size dissatisfaction) measured 15 days apart in a subset of 100 participants. Intraclass correlation coefficients were reported as high across all four variables, indicating good test-retest reliability. This appears to be a methodological subsection of a larger study, with no explicit study numbering provided.
